thread:
sam: Heads-up — change window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. Planning to deploy runtime v2.3.0, api v1.9.1, console patch (ui/metric-tagging), and router header-split flag. Need cross-service sequencing and a config freeze during the window. @lina @mike @eva please chime in. I'll kick a small canary at +10m.

lina: Ok. I have a KV schema migration that I want toggled behind a feature flag. Prefer not to run the full migrate during the window — can we use a toggle + gradual backfill? :thinking: 

mike: Router side: header-split is backward compatible but requires the API to accept `x-rd-pref` and default fallback. We should bump API contract but keep compatibility mode for 48h. I can add the fallback today.

eva: I'll watch SLOs and metrics during the window. Can someone add ops-dash link when canary starts? Also set an alert for 5xx spike > 0.5%.

deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled by @sam for 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary plan: 3% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% if no regressions. Rollback criteria: >0.5% 5xx or latency p95 increase > 150ms.

lina: For the schema: I can deploy toggled change in console/runtime with no DB rewrite. Backfill job runs async. Will include an opt-out flag `--no-backfill` if we need emergency rollback.

sam: Sounds good. Sequence proposal: 1) API 1.9.1 (with compatibility flag), 2) Router header change (can enable header-split but keep old header alive), 3) runtime v2.3.0, 4) console patch. Canary across API+router together, then runtime and console staged. Any issues?

mike: Sequence ok. One note: router requires a small header validation change in the api common lib — I can push a tiny compatibility shim to avoid strict parsing failures.

lina: Need a config freeze for gateway + runtime config after API canary passes. I'll lock `rd-config` at commit `a1b2c3` for the window.

eva: ops-dash link: https://grafana.redwood/ops/d/abc123/deploy-watch (I'll pin in the channel when canary begins). Alert rule created: `deploy-window-5xx-spike`.

sam: Quick checklist before window: release notes updated, health-check endpoints smoke test, contract bump note in API docs, ops slack alarm, rollforward tag created. Anything else?

mike: Add a short integration test that sends the new header + old header and verifies fallback. I'll run it now and push results.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 02:10 UTC: API 1.9.1 -> 3% traffic.

eva: Watching charts — p95 and error rate steady so far. No anomalies at 3%.

lina: API canary looks clean from schema perspective. Locking rd-config at `a1b2c3` now.

deploy-bot: Router header-split flag toggled for canary traffic at 02:24 UTC. 3% -> 25%.

sam: Expanding to runtime canary now (2.3.0) at 02:30. Console patch queued but held at 0% until runtime looked OK.

deploy-bot: Runtime canary deployed to canary pool. Running perf probe.

eva: Noticing a small p50 increase (~30ms) but p95 stable. No 5xx spike. Still under thresholds.

mike: Integration test passed locally. No parsing errors.

lina: Backfill not started yet (kicked off separately). We should be safe to continue.

deploy-bot: Runtime canary healthy at 25% -> proceeding to 100% at 02:45.

sam: Hold on console — getting reports of intermittent 503s from the console canary cluster. @lina can you check console logs? @eva please check downstream API call errors.

lina: Checking logs: console -> api calls show intermittent `upstream reset` at ~02:47. Stacktrace points to a short-lived connection pool exhaustion when runtime connections spike.

eva: Alerts fired: `deploy-window-5xx-spike` triggered at 02:48 for console canary (503 ~0.7%). API and runtime global metrics still fine.

sam: Decision: rollback console patch only for now to limit blast radius. Keep API/runtime/router at new versions. Rollback console canary to previous image and stop backfill. We'll investigate connection pooling.

deploy-bot: Rolling back console patch on canary cluster to image `console:20260214-rc` at 02:52 UTC. Canary stopped.

lina: Confirmed: console canary reverted, 503s cleared. I'll open a ticket to increase runtime connection pool defaults and add a soft limit guard.

mike: Good call. I'll add a graceful reconnect and bump the http2 concurrent streams default in router to avoid hitting exhaustion.

eva: Ops metrics back to baseline. No further alerts.

sam: Summary for release notes & postmortem: API v1.9.1 and runtime v2.3.0 rolled to prod; router header-split enabled with fallback; console patch rolled back from canary due to connection pool exhaustion causing 503s. Action items: increase pool defaults (lina), router stream defaults (mike), add a synthetic test exercising console->api at scale (eva). Re-run console patch after fixes — propose next window tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

lina: I'll file ticket RW-3219 and include logs + repro steps.

mike: I'll send a quick PR for router defaults and a changelog entry.

eva: I'll prepare a short post-capture dashboard with the canary timeline and attach it to the ticket.

sam: Thanks all. I'll update the release notes and mark this window as partially successful. Re-run plan for console tomorrow. :thumbsup:
